ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why variance is real and one losing month proves nothing
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text: One losing month doesn't mean your system is broken.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text: Most bettors quit after a cold streak and assume they had a bad strategy. They didn't. They had a bad sample.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text: At a 54% win rate, you will still lose 4 or 5 in a row regularly. That's not failure. That's math. The edge is invisible in small samples and obvious over hundreds of bets.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text: Example: flip a coin weighted 54-46. In 20 flips you might go 8-12. In 500 flips you'll be close to 270-230. The edge only shows up with volume.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text: 49 days in, we're 259-221 at 54.0% with +40.1u. The month-to-month line is bumpy. The year-to-date line is not.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: One cold month is noise. 49 days and +40.1u is signal. Variance is real and it cuts both ways. Stay with the process.
